title: Audit trail
idea: Audit trail: Chronological events expose actor action resource and provenance
audience: People who need to audit within a dashboard surface.
avoidWhen: The log omits authoritative source identity
distinctFrom: Differs from a generic timeline layout through its audit priority and explicit commitment contract: Events are immutable and redaction policy explicit
navigation: Audit trail keeps the current audit context visible; secondary detail has an explicit return path.

composition.entry: Chronological events expose actor action resource and provenance
composition.continuation: Continue with the evidence and controls needed to audit; privileged changes must be traceable
composition.priority: Events are immutable and redaction policy explicit

imagery.role: Support the actual audit context; essential controls and state remain native.

brandConstraints: Preserve approved identity, semantic roles and licensed assets.
Treat font and palette suggestions as optional; do not replace fixed branding.
responsiveRules: Use text-first event detail with persistent filters
Keep units, filters and selection understandable at narrow widths; expose a focused item view.

stateContracts.loading: Keep the audit trail structure stable while authoritative content resolves; expose unavailable action state.
stateContracts.empty: Explain why no audit content is available and offer a relevant next action.
stateContracts.failure: Preserve safe context and identify the failed operation; Events are immutable and redaction policy explicit
stateContracts.offline: Label cached/unsynchronized audit content and prevent claims of server completion.
stateContracts.success: Events are immutable and redaction policy explicit
stateContracts.interruption: Restore the active audit context safely after navigation, focus loss or platform interruption; do not replay committed actions.

accessibilityRisks: Do not communicate state through color alone; name controls and expose current selection.
Verify reading order, input alternatives, enlarged text and focus restoration for this composition.

performanceBudget.principle: Set an explicit project budget from the actual content/device; no unsupported universal frame or bundle promise.
performanceBudget.verify: Measure bounded queries and large-data interaction; virtualize only with accessible alternatives.

reviewNotes: Original authored candidate with browser study renders. Automated browser checks are recorded in evals/specimen-review.json. No independent visual comparison, task study or native runtime verification; remains draft. The illustration/task content demonstrates composition and does not prescribe every linked palette or font.
